changelog: Your phone finds your computer on Wi-Fi again. When your router handed the computer a new address, the phone had no way to learn it — so it quietly fell back to the remote (Tailscale) connection and stayed there, even when both were sitting on the same Wi-Fi. The phone now picks up the new address the next time it reaches your computer by any route, so it corrects itself without you re-pairing. "Connected · Wi-Fi / remote (tunnel)" and the Test button now report the connection you're actually on instead of guessing.
